I’m thinking about using Python shell to walk or read through directories since specialized tools are unavailable right now. args.command:

import os,re
patterns=[
 ('sql',re.compile(r'create\s+table\s+(?:if\s+not\s+exists\s+)?[`"\[]?memo\b',re.I),{'.sql'}),
 ('go',re.compile(r'\btype\s+Memo\s+struct\b'),{'.go'}),
 ('proto',re.compile(r'\bmessage\s+Memo\b'),{'.proto'}),
 ('frontend',re.compile(r'\b(?:export\s+)?(?:interface|type)\s+Memo\b'),{'.ts','.tsx'}),
]
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('.'):
 dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in {'.git','node_modules','vendor'}]
 for f in files:
  ext=os.path.splitext(f)[1]
  relevant=[p for p in patterns if ext in p[2]]
  if not relevant: continue
  path=os.path.join(root,f)
  try:
   text=open(path,encoding='utf-8').read()
  except: continue
  for label,rx,_ in relevant:
   if rx.search(text): print(f'{label}: {path[2:]}')
PY
